Stage 4 · Java foundations

Traversing Arrays

Two tour buses: counting (writes) vs sightseeing (reads).

⏱ 15 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Count seats or greet faces?

Photos can’t move furniture.

🚌

Two buses. Classic for counts seats (has the INDEX — can repaint). for-each greets passengers (no index). Editing the for-each photo (v += 5) changes NOTHING in the tray!

ProgramRead each line in order
public class Main {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    int[] m = {80, 90, 70};
    int sum = 0;
    for (int v : m) {
      sum += v; // sightseeing: read-only tour
    }
    System.out.println("sum = " + sum);
    for (int i = 0; i < m.length; i++) {
      m[i] += 5; // counting bus: repaint every seat
    }
    System.out.println("first now = " + m[0]);
  }
}

Read tour sums 240; write tour upgrades to 85.

for-each sum
240
Read only
m[0] after +5
85
Upgraded
Accumulators init BEFORE the loop (sum = 0). #1 traversal bug otherwise.
